note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2): each figure acts out its word's new hook. Wooden column in the middle: feminine words left (with the glazed street door), masculine right (with the stairs up). One box per item.

items.label: la glace
items.scene: A girl licks a pink ICE CREAM piled high in a tall GLASS (GLAHS).

items.label: la bière
items.scene: A BEE in the AIR (BYEHR) hovers over a frothy glass of BEER.

items.label: la cigarette
items.scene: Same as English 'cigarette' (said see-gah-REHT): a CIGARETTE rests in an ashtray on the terrace table, nobody smoking it.

items.label: la terrasse
items.scene: Same as English 'terrace' (said teh-RAHS): two friends chat at a sunny café TERRACE table under a parasol.

items.label: la soif
items.scene: A SUAVE fox in a bow tie (SWAHF) is dying of THIRST, tongue out, reaching for a water jug.

items.label: la boisson
items.scene: A BOY sings a SONG (bwah-SOHN) into a bottle of fizzy DRINK as if it were a microphone.

items.label: la tasse
items.scene: A juggler TOSSES (TAHS) a CUP and saucer high in the air.

items.label: le café
items.scene: Same as English 'café' (said kah-FAY): a sleepy owl sips a tiny cup of black COFFEE.

items.label: le bar
items.scene: Same as English 'bar' (said BAHR): a sheep polishes the shiny zinc BAR counter with a cloth.

items.label: le thé
items.scene: A ginger cat swishes its long TAIL (TAY) while it stirs a steaming cup of TEA.

items.label: le plateau
items.scene: A waitress gasps 'OH!' as her TRAY of flat ('PLAT') plates wobbles (plah-TOH).

items.label: le jus
items.scene: A ZOO giraffe (ZHEW) sips orange JUICE through a very long straw.

items.label: le bistrot
items.scene: Same as English 'bistro', silent t (bees-TROH): a poodle sips coffee at the window of a little BISTRO with checked curtains.

items.label: l'apéritif
items.scene: Same as English 'aperitif' (said ah-pay-ree-TEEF): an elegant goose raises a small pre-dinner APERITIF glass beside a bowl of olives.

items.label: le tilleul
items.scene: Beside a YULE log, granny pours a cup of LIME-BLOSSOM TEA (tee-YUHL) from a sprig of linden flowers.
